text: China urges New Zealand to strictly abide by international law and basic norms governing international relations, respect China's sovereignty and security concerns, and safeguard the safety and order of civil aviation, Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said at a press

text:
China has delivered a significant batch of emergency humanitarian aid to Iran, consisting of 58 tonnes of urgently needed medical supplies, as Iran grapples with the consequences of the recent attack by the United States and Israel.

The aid was formally handed over on Wednesday
translated_text:
在伊朗努力应对美国和以色列最近袭击的后果之际，中国已向伊朗提供了大量紧急人道主义援助，其中包括58吨急需的医疗物资。

援助物资已于周三正式移交
